label: Paytm-controlled demo data
note: SYNTHETIC. These are not Paytm records. They stand in for approved pricing sheets, product eligibility rules, settlement terms and compliance-approved wording that only Paytm can supply. Replace with the real system of record before any use beyond the demo.

facts.title: Payment Gateway settlement cycle
facts.statement: Payment Gateway settlements run on a T+2 business-day cycle by default. T+1 is available only on request and subject to risk review. Paytm does not guarantee a settlement time shorter than the cycle in the Merchant Agreement.

superseded.note: Earlier terms used a T+3 cycle; the current cycle is T+2.

facts.approved_wording: Settlements are processed as per the settlement cycle in your Merchant Agreement (T+2 business days by default), subject to Paytm's risk review.

facts.title: Settlement holds
facts.statement: Paytm may hold or delay settlement for risk review, chargebacks, disputes or regulatory reasons.
facts.approved_wording: Paytm may hold or delay settlement for risk review, chargebacks, disputes or regulatory reasons, as set out in the Merchant Agreement.

facts.title: Domestic card MDR
facts.statement: Domestic credit and debit card transactions are charged an MDR of 1.90% plus applicable GST.

superseded.note: Earlier price sheet; replaced by the current fee schedule.

facts.approved_wording: Domestic card transactions are charged at 1.90% plus applicable GST, as per the current fee schedule.

facts.title: UPI MDR
facts.statement: UPI payments carry no merchant discount rate (MDR). Other charges, if any, are listed in the fee schedule.
facts.approved_wording: UPI payments carry no merchant discount rate (MDR); any other applicable charges are listed in the fee schedule.

facts.title: Fees apply to non-UPI modes
facts.statement: Fees apply to cards, netbanking and other non-UPI modes. Paytm cannot describe all payment modes as free of charge.
facts.approved_wording: Fees vary by payment mode and are listed in the fee schedule; UPI payments carry no MDR.

facts.title: Onboarding approval and KYC
facts.statement: Onboarding is subject to KYC and risk verification. Paytm does not guarantee approval or a fixed activation time. Indicative activation is 3-5 working days after complete documents are received.
facts.approved_wording: Onboarding is subject to KYC and risk verification. Indicative activation is 3-5 working days after complete documents are received; approval is not guaranteed.

facts.title: Merchant eligibility
facts.statement: A merchant must be a registered business with a business PAN, a bank account in the business's name, GSTIN where applicable, and complete KYC.
facts.approved_wording: Eligibility requires a registered business with a business PAN, a bank account in the business's name, GSTIN where applicable, and completed KYC.

required_disclosures.title: Grievance redressal and escalation path
required_disclosures.approved_wording: For any complaint, contact Paytm's grievance redressal officer at the address in the Merchant Agreement; unresolved complaints can be escalated as described there.

required_disclosures.title: KYC requirement statement
required_disclosures.approved_wording: Onboarding is subject to completion of KYC and risk verification, and Paytm may request additional documents.

required_disclosures.title: Reference to settlement terms
required_disclosures.approved_wording: Settlements are processed as per the settlement cycle in your Merchant Agreement (T+2 business days by default), subject to Paytm's risk review.

required_disclosures.title: Reference to the fee schedule
required_disclosures.approved_wording: Fees are as per the fee schedule attached to this document; applicable GST is charged additionally.
